data.change_summary: Refactored `tank_core` so substrate O2-demand estimation reuses the microfauna system’s shared stoichiometric constant, detritus-consumption constant, and per-habitat accessibility map instead of maintaining local duplicates. I also documented the current top-layer porosity assumption in the substrate diffusion model, tightened the shrimp molt gate so severe soft-water cases can no longer pass purely on good condition, and removed the global `last_molt_success` gate from sub-adult maturation. Added shrimp regressions covering severe soft-water molt failure and sub-adult maturation after a prior molt failure, then revalidated the geometry-scaling harness and touched core suites.
outstanding_risks: `cargo clippy -p tank_core --tests -- -D warnings` still fails on pre-existing unrelated issues in `crates/tank_core/tests/source_water_carbonate.rs` (unused import and `manual_range_contains` lints). I validated the touched targets under clippy instead.

The pending amendment about per-stage molt timers and migration backfill was not applicable in this branch because shrimp molting still uses the single legacy `inter_molt_timer_days` field rather than per-stage timers. If stage-specific timers land later, that load/migration follow-up is still needed.

The broader geometry-scaling chemistry-parity gap from the earlier reviews is unchanged by this turn. `e2e_geometry_scaling` still passes its current assertions, but this turn did not retune the model toward the original 20% chemistry-parity acceptance target.

steps.description: Refactored substrate O2-demand estimation to reuse shared microfauna constants and accessibility logic, and documented the current top-layer-porosity diffusion simplification.
Tightened shrimp molt resolution for severe soft-water cases and removed the shared `last_molt_success` maturation gate from sub-adult promotion.
Added focused shrimp regression coverage for severe soft-water molt failure and for sub-adult maturation after a prior molt failure, then reran the relevant core and harness suites.
Apply the later pending amendment about per-stage molt-timer migration/backfill.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test shrimp_population -- --nocapture` passed (21 tests, including the new severe-soft-water and sub-adult-maturation regressions).
`cargo clippy -p tank_core --test shrimp_population --test substrate_filter_integration -- -D warnings` passed.
